title: CAD2Cube DXF 3D-consumer and DWG-route revalidation
mode: Primary-source open-source repository and consumer-route review; research-only plan refinement
worktreeState: Dirty shared worktree; preserved existing changes
scope: Screen an additional Blender-based explicit-geometry DXF consumer.
Reconcile current repository description, README, and extension manifest for version and DWG route scope.
Distinguish consumer projection from independent parser, DWG conversion, MESH, ACIS/AcDs, and B-rep claims.
Add a bounded optional composed-check recipe without changing implementation order or validation cadence.

sources.name: CAD2Cube current README
sources.observed: The mutable main README identifies its documented source as v1.5.0 and describes a standalone DXF importer after removal of its ODA-based DWG conversion. It documents 3DFACE, SOLID, 2D/3D POLYLINE, and HATCH projection; 3DSOLID is planned, and MESH is not listed. Its optional 3DFACE merge changes many face records into a Blender mesh, so post-merge object counts are not source-entity disposition evidence. These v1.5.0 statements are not attributed to the newer v1.5.1 release without immutable source/artifact binding.

sources.name: CAD2Cube Blender extension manifest
sources.observed: The mutable main manifest identifies version 1.5.0, Blender 4.2+, and bundled ezdxf 1.4.4. This is a package declaration, not an immutable artifact/source binding or an execution result.

sources.name: CAD2Cube GitHub releases and v1.5.1 release notes
sources.observed: The release page lists v1.5.1 at signed/verified tag commit d07bdb0 as Latest, released 2026-09-28. Its notes mention curve-data and linetype changes but do not bind a tagged README, Blender manifest, bundled ezdxf wheel, or extension asset to the inspected mutable main files. Therefore v1.5.1 source/artifact identity and its DWG route remain LATEST_RELEASE_SOURCE_UNBOUND; do not infer that the v1.5.0 ODA-converter removal applies to it. The tagged files and release asset were not retrieved in this pass.

sources.name: Autodesk MESH DXF reference
sources.observed: The MESH record is an AcDbSubDMesh schema with version, subdivision level, vertices, face-list, edges, crease values, and property-override fields. This is a distinct record family from 3DFACE and does not establish a consumer's support.

sources.name: FreeCAD Draft DXF consumer guide
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents separate built-in C++ and legacy Python importer entity lists and says embedded ACIS solids cannot currently be read by stock FreeCAD. The CAD2Cube route is not a replacement for importer-specific native FreeCAD qualification.

sources.name: ezdxf ACIS API
sources.observed: CAD2Cube's bundled parser lineage is ezdxf. ezdxf's bounded ACIS carrier/projection behavior does not make the add-on an independent DXF parser or complete B-rep geometry oracle.

assessment.planImpact: Reconciles a latest-release/source mismatch for the already-tracked CAD2Cube candidate: the release page lists v1.5.1 at d07bdb0, but only mutable v1.5.0 README/manifest evidence was inspectable. Keep the candidate source/artifact and current DWG route unqualified until bound. The inspectable v1.5.0 route bundles ezdxf and projects selected explicit DXF geometry into Blender; merge-induced identity loss and undocumented MESH/planned 3DSOLID prevent independent-parser or solid-semantic credit. Implementation order, fast/full validation cadence, and support claims remain unchanged.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review and local plan crosswalk
method.limitations: The v1.5.1 release page and release notes were inspected, but the tagged README/manifest and release asset were not retrieved; mutable main README and manifest identify v1.5.0 and remain unbound to v1.5.1. No Blender/add-on execution occurred. The v1.5.0 route is a downstream geometry projection that bundles ezdxf; neither its documentation nor this source review qualifies v1.5.1 behavior, raw DXF preservation, a current DWG route, MESH, ACIS/AcDs, B-rep semantics, or FreeCAD behavior.
